description:
Search for targets by gene symbol or name.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table target — one record = one Ensembl human gene.
Key: id.
Results: ranked by match_class asc, then approvedSymbol asc (verified by the harness); `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
pathways: mixed direct and propagated annotations.
go: direct annotations only.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Every Ensembl human gene in Open Targets 25.09 (existence only).
